editor.label: Resume the last prospect at start-up
editor.description: Loads the prospect named below when the server starts.

editor.label: Last prospect
editor.description: Written by the server whenever a prospect is played. Saves are in Icarus/Saved/PlayerData/DedicatedServer/Prospects.

editor.label: Load this prospect at start-up
editor.description: Name of a saved prospect (the file name without .json). Leave empty to resume the last one or wait in the lobby.

editor.label: Create a prospect at start-up
editor.description: Format: [ProspectType] [Difficulty 1-4] [Hardcore true/false] [SaveName], e.g. OpenWorld_Styx 2 false MyWorld. Not every game version honours it; players can always create a prospect from the lobby. Clear it after the prospect exists.

editor.label: Players can launch prospects
editor.description: When off, only admins can create or load prospects from the lobby.

editor.label: Save the prospect when the server stops
Return to the lobby if nobody joins within (seconds)
editor.description: The prospect is paused and saved, then the server goes back to the lobby. -1 = never.

editor.label: Return to the lobby when empty for (seconds)
editor.description: The prospect is saved and the server goes back to the lobby once the last player leaves. -1 = never.

editor.label: Server name
editor.description: Shown in the server browser (64 characters at most).

editor.label: Join password
editor.description: Leave empty for a public server.

editor.label: Admin password
editor.description: Players type /AdminLogin <password> in the chat to become admin. Set one: when it is empty, anyone who types /AdminLogin gets admin rights.

script.name: Save the prospect and shut down
script.description: Sends Ctrl+C to the server process, which saves the running prospect and exits.

script.name: Install Wine and its dependencies
script.description: Installs wine, winetricks, Xvfb and xdotool on the host (apt, dnf or yum) and the Windows runtimes the server needs into its Wine prefix. Skips what is already installed.
